title: Grade 3 English: Singapore MOE Synthesis
description: Grammar cloze, sentence synthesis, contextual vocabulary and connectors.

items.prompt: Combine the sentences using 'Although': 'Milo was feeling very tired.' 'Milo continued working on his puzzle.'

options.text: Although Milo was tired, he stopped the puzzle.
Although Milo was rested, he quit the puzzle.
Although Milo was tired, he continued the puzzle.
Although Milo was rested, he hid the puzzle.

items.explanation: 'Although' shows that Milo kept working even though he was tired.

items.prompt: Neither of the boys ___ going to the museum today.
items.explanation: 'Neither' is a singular indefinite pronoun requiring the singular verb 'is'.

items.prompt: Maxine looked ___ her missing keys everywhere before finding them under the sofa.
items.explanation: The phrasal verb 'look for' means to search for something.

items.prompt: Choose the word closest in meaning to 'diligent': 'The diligent student completed all her assignments early.'
You must complete your homework ___ you can play video games.
items.explanation: 'Before' establishes the necessary chronological sequence of tasks.

items.prompt: The flock of birds ___ flying towards the warm southern islands.
items.explanation: Collective nouns like 'flock' acting as a single unit take singular verbs ('is').

items.prompt: Rewrite as reported speech: 'I am reading a good book,' said Milo.

options.text: Milo said that he was reading a good book.
Milo says that he is reading a book.
Milo told that I am reading.
Milo will say he read a book.

items.explanation: Direct speech in present continuous shifts back to past continuous ('was reading') in reported speech.

items.prompt: The soup was ___ hot for the young child to drink.
items.explanation: 'Too' is the adverb of degree indicating an excessive amount.

options.text: "Lets go to the park" shouted Maxine.
"Lets go, to the park! shouted Maxine.
"Let's go to the park!" shouted Maxine.
Let's go to the park shouted Maxine!

items.explanation: Contains opening/closing quotation marks, contraction apostrophe in 'Let's', and exclamation mark inside the quotes.

items.prompt: Which idiom means 'to face a difficult situation with courage'?
items.explanation: 'Bite the bullet' means to endure a painful or difficult situation bravely.
